proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D hABC h
  have e : EuclideanGeometry.angle A C D = EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C + EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C := by
    linarith [EuclideanGeometry.exterior_angle_eq_angle_add_angle (p₃ := A) D h.symm, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm C A B]
  have p1 : 0 < EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C := EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear hABC
  have p2 : 0 < EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C :=
    EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear (by rwa [Set.insert_comm])
  constructor <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → Sbtw ℝ B C D → EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C < EuclideanGeometry.angle A C D ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C < EuclideanGeometry.angle A C D
